83)༄༅/(nyid kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs las brtsams te zhabs brtan smon tshig)pad+ma rnam par rgyas pa'i skyed tshal du/ /kun bzang smon pa'i stobs kyis skya

tei:div.tei:p: (nyid kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs las brtsams te zhabs brtan smon tshig) pad+ma rnam par rgyas pa'i skyed tshal du// kun bzang smon pa'i stobs kyis skyed bsrings ba'i// rgyal bstan rin chen 'dzin pa'i bung ba'i tshogs// blo gsas nor bu mchog la gsol ba 'debs// thub dbang mchog gi bstan pa'i mdzod khang nas// lung dang rtogs pa'i chos tshul rab 'byams kyi// yon tan 'khur chen 'degs pa'i glang po'i khyu// dam pa'i skyes bu mchog rnams zhabs brtan shog rgyal sras 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sgyu thabs kyis// phrin las gzhan phan lhun gyis grub pa'i gter// mang thos blo gros rab yangs kun dga'i skyes// mkhyen rtogs yon tan mnga' rnams 'tsho bzhes gsol// sgra dbyangs lha mo mgrin pa'i 'o mtshor zhugs// blo gros pad+ma'i 'dab stong snying la bkra// byang chub myu gu thar pa'i sa la smin// gtsug lag snang ba mchog rnams yun brtan shog /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid spros dang bral// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbyings// dag mnyam bde chen dbyer med rdo rje'i bdag /he ru ka dpal g.yung drung chen por bzhugs// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang 84)ston pa yi// gsang chen theg pa mchog gi bstan pa ni// ji bzhin 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rgyal mtshan sgreng*// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog rnams rtag brtan gsol// 'khor 'das spyi dpal chen po he ru ka /rab 'byams 'dus pa chen po spro dang sdud// rig rtsal rol pa chen por mnga' dbang sgyur// dbang phyug yon tan mnga' rnams rtag brtan bzhugs// ye gnas gdod ma rang babs gnyug ma'i dbyings// ma 'gags rang mdangs 'od gsal chos kyi sku// 'dren pa rnams kyis yongs spangs gdul ka'i 'gro// 'dul mdzad dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes gsol/ zhes pa'ang 'dren pa rnams kyis ming gi cod paṇa gnang ba las brtsams/ dam pa rnams kyi zhabs brtan smon tshig tu bla ma bde chen rgya mtsho'i bskul ma gnang ba bzhin dpal gyi ming gis brgyan pa'i dzo ki des gang dran bris pa dge/
gsol 'debs su bsgyur na/ mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes sogs skabs bab kha bsgyur bas grub bo// dge'o//
